en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch an action movie
Watch a comedy movie
Watch an anime movie

...I often wonder why action movies always
depict robots as so violent.

There are actually many benevolent robots
who wish to live in peace among humans.

The creators of these films are reinforcing
the toxic attitudes that lead to robophobia!

If they won't change their ways, then I'll form
my own advocacy group to fight their bigotry!

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't know if there are enough of
you to make an advocacy group...
I, too, enjoy comedy movies!

I enjoy them because they entertain people
without being pretentious.

I hope someday to be the kind of robot who
makes people smile, just like comedy movies.
I enjoy anime, too.

Specifically, I really relate to anime
where robots are a force for good.

Perhaps robophobia will vanish from society
as these movies become more popular.

Someday I, too, will play an active role in 
abolishing robophobia!

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
(*sigh*)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Keebo's inner thoughts...?
